text.title: Outcome Based Roadmaps Advanced Worked Example
text.summary: One end-to-end worked example for Outcome Based Roadmaps Advanced: trigger fires, inputs gathered, artefact produced and validated against output contract.

example.title: Happy-path application
example.trigger: Operator opens calendar slot named in Applies If; preconditions are met.
example.validation: Run scripts/validate-outcome-based-roadmaps-advanced.py against the produced artefact. Expected exit 0 (ok).
example.downstream: Artefact handed off to the consumers named in Related; outcome reviewed at next iteration.

example.title: ARR goal decomposed across a three-quarter chain
example.trigger: Board sets 'increase ARR 20% by EOY26'; a base quarterly roadmap already exists and needs horizon depth.
example.inputs: Business goal restated as metric + current + target + deadline (the one permitted date). Two product lanes, instrumented churn and activation dashboards.
example.validation: Confidence on e-onboarding-wedge moves medium to high only after the week-4 read clears the pre-registered bar — never on the strength of the plan itself (r3 + r9).
example.downstream: All four audience views are re-rendered from this tree; none is edited in place (r10).

example.title: Un-anchored application
example.trigger: Operator skipped Applies If gate; preconditions not verified.
example.inputs: Free-text prose substitutes; no cited evidence.
example.validation: Validator returns non-zero with violation list per forbidden patterns in content/02-output-contract.xml.
example.downstream: Artefact rejected; consumers do not read; operator reruns with full preconditions.
